title: Asymptotic classes via definable quotients
summary: In this paper, we study when uniform interpretations and definable quotients preserve finite-dimensional asymptotic classes. Counting in the ambient structures gives finitely many asymptotic alternatives. However, the corresponding parameter sets need not be definable in the interpreted language, so in general the interpreted class is only weakly asymptotic. We define trace reflection, a one-sided condition which ensures this definability.
